label: Lamassu-SMEK system
definition: A Lamassu system in which an organism possesses a locus encoding an LmuA effector with a SMEK domain, an SMC-like LmuB sensor, and LmuC.
observations: Three-component SMEK-bearing Lamassu architecture, not single-gene DS-27. No short-only restriction: the dataset has one long-profile exception requiring review. Genomic example only; no SMEK chemistry asserted.
